newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Union Bank sees '97 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Union Bank sees '97 profit rise.

text.p: One of the leading banks in Estonia, Union Bank, on Thursday forecast a 1997 profit of 105.8 million kroons after a 57 million kroon profit in 1996.
Union Bank is merging with fifth bank, North Estonian Bank, and said its profit forecast was for the combined banks.
It said in a statement that the banks' combined profit in 1996 was 72.6 million kroons. Union Bank's profit alone was 57 million kroons. Union Bank is quoted in Helsinki and Tallinn.
Union Bank said that its balance sheet total was expected to be 7.5 billion kroons at the end of 1997 versus the combined banks' balance sheet total of 4.9 billion kroons at end 1996.
The bank added that its loan portfolio was expected to rise to 4.1 billion kroons from 2.5 billion while client deposits were expected to gain to 5.1 billion kroons from 3.3 billion.
The bank said that its forecasts were based on expected Estonian economic growth of three percent in 1997 and inflation of 14.5 percent.
